items.title: LACER SUITES Kamakura Opens After Rebranding Former Kamakura Aoyama - TRAICY Global
items.raw_summary: Creal Hotels opened “LACER SUITES Kamakura” on May 18. The property is a rebranded version of the former Kamakura Aoyama hotel. It is the third hotel under the company’s “LACER” brand and is positioned as the top-tier model “LACER SUITES.” The hotel offers 36 guest rooms in 6 types. To meet inbound demand from overseas visitors, some rooms have been renovated and more rooms suitable for multiple guests have been added. Guest rooms feature a simple interior based on the theme of “plainness,” with a layout that highlights the texture and quality of the materials. items.title: Livemax Resort Hakodate Shikabe Onsen Opens After Rebranding - TRAICY Global
items.raw_summary: Livemax opened “Livemax Resort Hakodate Shikabe Onsen” on May 29. The property is a rebranded version of the former Royal Hotel Minami Hokkaido Shikabe. Guest rooms come in three types: Japanese-style rooms, Western-style rooms, and Japanese-Western combination rooms. Inside the hotel, there is a large public bath with natural hot springs and a sauna, as well as an open-air rock bath designed like a garden with rocks and plantings, allowing guests to bathe while enjoying seasonal scenery. Dining options feature menus that use ingredients produced in Hokkaido and fresh seafood from the surrounding seas.
